common_hand.note: Four chows and a pair that is not a dragon or your wind.

self_draw.note: Any winning hand, finished with a tile you drew yourself.

concealed.note: Any winning hand with no claimed sets.

fully_concealed.note: No claimed sets, and finished with a tile you drew yourself.

dragon_pung.note: Counts once for each dragon pung.

seat_wind_pung.note: A pung of your own seat's wind (East in this example).

round_wind_pung.note: A pung of the round's wind (East in this example).

pure_one_suit.note: One numbered suit and nothing else.

small_three_dragons.note: Two dragon pungs and a pair of the third.

small_four_winds.note: Three wind pungs and a pair of the fourth.

thirteen_orphans.note: One of every 1, 9, wind and dragon, plus a second of any of them.

outside_hand.note: Every set and the pair has a 1, a 9 or an honour.

all_green.note: Only 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 of bamboo and the green dragon.

all_simples.note: Only 2 to 8 of the numbered suits.
